title: Silver Coins, Rounds, and Bars: Which Should You Buy First
description: Coins, rounds, and bars all hold silver but they're not the same buy. Here is how premiums, liquidity, and storage differ across the three so you can decide what to buy first.
alt: Four data cards comparing silver product types: coins at 22% premium, rounds at 5% premium, bars at 2% premium, and all types at .999 fine silver purity
